source.custom_query: SELECT ct.customer_trx_id, ct.trx_number, ct.trx_date, hp.party_name AS customer_name, ct.invoice_currency_code, ct.org_id FROM apps.ra_customer_trx_all ct LEFT JOIN apps.hz_cust_accounts ca ON ct.bill_to_customer_id = ca.cust_account_id LEFT JOIN apps.hz_parties hp ON ca.party_id = hp.party_id WHERE ct.org_id = 204 AND ROWNUM <= 50
